title: TWITTER Little White Rabbit custom option matrix
notes: Current indexed options identify TWITTER / 骓特 小白兔定制款 in blue-white and pink-white, sizes 44-56 cm, with alloy or wave-carbon wheels and either 24-speed mechanical shifting or Wheeltop wireless electronic shifting. A separate current JD brand index names a Shuntai 24-speed hydraulic-disc option. These third-party marketplace indexes establish the option conflict but do not prove which drivetrain, wheelset or size belongs to the retained CNY 6,951 search card.
